decisions.reason: As a flagship multi-model range close to the firm’s core safety-footwear business, it is relatively cheap to continue while preserving upside in a growing market, so real-options logic favors keeping it.
This occupational-shoe variant is still close to existing capabilities and channels, but as a more specialized single offer its upside is less certain, so it is kept with a higher abandonment risk.
A multi-model safety-shoe series fits the firm’s broad established portfolio and can remain on the market at moderate cost until demand signals are clearer, making retention the more likely choice.
